title.en: The diagonal parallel to the main

description.zh:
主對角線距離：請依照下方英文原題的輸入、輸出規格完成程式。

Python 二維 list 在此章對應 vector>；第一個索引是列，第二個索引是欄。
description.en:
Given an integer \( n \), produce a two-dimensional array of size \( \left ( n \times n \right ) \) and complete it according to the following rules, and print with a single space between characters:

  • On the main diagonal write 0 .
  • On the diagonals adjacent to the main, write 1 .
  • On the next adjacent diagonals write 2 and so forth.

Print the elements of the resulting array.

C++ note: Use vector<vector<int>> for a two-dimensional array. The first index is the row and the second is the column.

hint.zh: Python 二維 list 在此章對應 vector<vector<int>>；第一個索引是列，第二個索引是欄。
hint.en: Use vector<vector<int>> for a two-dimensional array. The first index is the row and the second is the column.
